title: Length Of Longest Fibonacci Subsequence
description: Find the length of the longest subsequence that is Fibonacci-like. A sequence is Fibonacci-like if x1 + x2 = x3, x2 + x3 = x4, etc.
pseudocode:
1. let n = arr.length
2. let dp = new Map()
3. let maxLen = 0
4. for j from 0 to n-1
5.   for i from 0 to j-1
6.     let prev = arr[j] - arr[i]
7.     let k = map.get(prev)
8.     if k < i
9.       len = (dp.get(k + ',' + i) || 2) + 1
10.      dp.set(i + ',' + j, len)
11.      maxLen = Math.max(maxLen, len)

steps.note: Check i=1 (val 2), j=2 (val 3). Prev = 3-2 = 1. Found at index 0.
Check i=2 (val 3), j=3 (val 4). Prev = 4-3 = 1. Found at index 0 (k=0). k < i is true.
Check i=3 (val 4), j=4 (val 5). Prev = 5-4 = 1. Found at index 0.
Check i=4 (val 5), j=5 (val 8). Prev = 8-5 = 3. Found at index 2 (k=2). k < i is true.
Extending sequence [1, 2, 3] or [3, 5, 8]. Max sequence [1, 2, 3, 5, 8] detected.
